name: countdown-ring
prompt: Circular countdown ring that empties as the layer plays, on a transparent background; ring color and thickness controls.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a countdown ring shader with a transparent background. It starts at 12 o'clock and empties clockwise as the layer plays, with a faint track behind it. It hasn't been compiled or rendered because no Powermove tools were attached to this run. Inspector controls: uColor, uThickness, uRadius, uTrackOpacity and uRoundCaps; it outputs plain (not premultiplied) alpha.
